dash.note: Sales = amount billed. Money received = cash/UPI/other actually collected (including old udhar recovered, minus refunds). Cash movement = change in the cash drawer. None of these is profit.

inventory.name: Product
inventory.adjust_hint: Use this to correct the count after checking the shelf. It is recorded with your reason.
inventory.negative_confirm: This would make the stock of {name} negative. Continue?
inventory.negative_blocked: The stock of {name} cannot go below zero.
inventory.minimum_invalid: The minimum stock is not valid.
inventory.duplicate_name: A product with this name already exists.
applications.warning: Do not write passwords, OTPs or Aadhaar numbers anywhere in this app.
applications.sensitive: Looks like a password, OTP or Aadhaar number. These must not be saved here.
applications.bill_invalid: That bill number was not found for this customer.
report.note_sales: Sales is what was billed. Money received is cash/UPI/other actually collected, including old udhar recovered and job advances, minus refunds. Cash movement is the change in the cash drawer. They are different numbers.
report.note_profit: Estimated profit = sales - purchase cost of stationery sold - operating expenses. Paper, toner and machine wear per page are not costed, so this is an estimate, not accounting profit. Job orders are not counted in sales.
report.note_service: Cancelled and refunded bills are not included. Amounts are before bill-level discounts.
report.note_collections: Refunds are shown as negative amounts. Dates are the dates money was received or returned.
report.note_cash: Cash movement here = cash received - cash refunds - cash expenses. It is not the cash in the drawer unless you add the opening cash.
report.note_outstanding: Balances are as of today. Customers with nothing due are not listed.
report.note_expenses: Cancelled expenses are not included. Stock bought for resale belongs in Inventory, not here.
report.note_inventory: Stock value = quantity in stock x latest purchase price.
report.note_jobs: Jobs received in the period. Overdue = still open after the expected delivery date.
report.range_invalid: The 'to' date is before the 'from' date.
backup.invalid: This is not a valid XeroxPro backup, or the file is damaged.
backup.too_new: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Install the latest version first.
backup.dest_unwritable: Cannot write to that folder. Choose another folder or check the USB drive.
backup.no_space: Not enough free space in that folder.
backup.valid: This backup is good: {bills} bills, {customers} customers.
backup.confirm_restore:
Restore this backup?

All data entered after {when} will be replaced by the backup. A safety copy of your current data is saved first in the backup folder.
backup.restored: Restored. A safety copy of the previous data was saved as {name}.
backup.none_yet: No backup has been made yet.
backup.stale: No backup for {days} days or more. Go to Backup & Restore and press 'Back up now'.
backup.inside_data: This folder is on the same drive area as the data itself. Prefer another drive or a USB stick.
backup.instructions: Backups are single files. Keep a copy on a USB stick regularly. To move to a new computer, copy a backup file there and use 'Restore from a file'.
error.db_locked: The data file is busy. Close any other copy of XeroxPro and try again.
error.disk_full: The disk is full. Free some space, then try again.
error.db_readonly: The data file cannot be written. Check that the folder is not read-only.
